keyFindings.description: Round-1 finding 3's fixes (ask card refresh on issue.closed carrying a route change, and on a claim landing during an in-flight Inbox fetch) are proven only by unit tests; the tester did not drive them. The deployment rule for a reader-facing Dispatch change requires a browser-suite test failing before and passing at the head: add both cases to packages/dispatch/e2e (Playwright route.fetch then delayed route.fulfill for the in-flight Inbox).

The ask read keeps only RouteHolder from roster.reach and drops RouteStatus, so 'listener did not answer' and 'nobody holds the role' are both null: during a listener outage a held role route renders offline and uncounted while a session route is counted. Carry route_status (embed IssueRouteReach) and render unknown as unknown.

A receipt-timeout send is recorded failed though it may have landed, so the session gets both the mention and the outbox copy (tester reproduced); a row created over a minute before its claim does the same. Docs promise one copy: state the at-least-once exception in AGENTS.md, envoy.md, for-agents.md, the skill and the CHANGELOG.
The outbox's '1 minute' pending window duplicates api's claimLapsed by comment only; share one constant so the two cannot drift.
While a comment.created is deferred, its comment.edited/resolved/reopened can reach the session first (reorder new this round); document it in AGENTS.md beside the mention rule.
